script_text: Aries, Fire sign's Mars just flipped a switch on your money sector — and it's not letting you ignore it. Early week, Saturn in your 1st House squares Pluto in your 11th, firing up power struggles with friends and groups. Monday hits hardest — don't sign anything until Thursday. Mars in your 5th House trines Venus in your 4th, lighting up romance and creative sparks. The turning point hits Friday when the Sun enters your 3rd House, shifting your focus to communication and bold statements. Late week, Mercury conjuncts the Sun in Gemini energizes your words — pitch that new idea Saturday. Mars trine Jupiter in your 4th brings emotional fulfillment Sunday. Friday is your power day as Venus perfects in your 4th House. Monday is your worst — Saturn square Pluto demands patience. Channel Mars's Fire into your career pitch rather than impulsive spending. Follow for daily updates.
